objectives.title: ServerSurfer
objectives.prompt: The Arena's ServerSurfer endpoint fetches a URL for you. Abuse it to read the file /flag.txt on the server.
hints: Which query parameter of /vapi/serversurfer names what the server fetches?
The server blocks two ways of naming itself; look up server-side request forgery and URL schemes other than http.

steps.title: Find the parameter
steps.prompt: Which query parameter does the ServerSurfer endpoint fetch?

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets you make the server fetch a resource of your choice? (acronym)

objectives.title: API1: Broken Object Level Authorization
objectives.prompt: Register a user, then read another user's record through the API1 user endpoint. The flag is in that user's data.
hints: The user endpoint takes an ID in its path: does it check that the record is yours?

objectives.title: API2: Broken Authentication
objectives.prompt: Log in to API2 without being given credentials and read the logged-in user's details. The flag is in one user's details.
hints: Look in the Resources folder of the vAPI source for something to try against the login.
Look up credential stuffing.

objectives.title: API3: Excessive Data Exposure
objectives.prompt: The comments API returns more about each comment than the app shows. Find the flag in a comment's data.
hints: The Android app in the Resources folder shows which endpoints exist.
Read the raw JSON of the comments, not what the app displays.

objectives.title: API4: Lack of Resources and Rate Limiting
objectives.prompt: API4 logs you in with a one-time code. Get past it and read the user's details: the flag is there.
hints: How long is the OTP, and how many guesses does the server allow?

objectives.title: API5: Broken Function Level Authorization
objectives.prompt: Register as a normal user, then reach the API5 function meant for admins. The flag is in the admin's data.
hints: Admins use a different route: compare the singular and plural user endpoints.

objectives.title: API6: Mass Assignment
objectives.prompt: The API6 store gives credits only to well-behaved users. Get credits anyway and read your profile: the flag appears when you have them.
hints: Which properties does the user object have that the registration form never sends?

objectives.title: API7: Security Misconfiguration
objectives.prompt: API7 expects cross-origin requests. Find what its CORS configuration lets another origin do with a logged-in user's key: the flag comes with it.
hints: Send the key request with an Origin header and read the CORS response headers.
Look up CORS misconfiguration with credentials.

objectives.title: API8: Injection
objectives.prompt: You have no credentials for API8. Get past its login with an injection and read the user's secret: the flag.
hints: Which login fields end up in a database query?
Look up SQL injection in login forms.

objectives.title: API9: Improper Assets Management
objectives.prompt: API9 has just launched a v2 login with protections. Find what the old version still allows and log in as the user: the flag is in the account details.
hints: The v2 login is rate limited. Is v1 still served?
The PIN is short.

objectives.title: API10: Insufficient Logging and Monitoring
objectives.prompt: Nothing in API10 is logged or monitored. Find its endpoint and take the flag.
hints: The Postman collection lists the API10 request.

objectives.title: JustWeakToken
objectives.prompt: The Arena's JustWeakToken endpoint issues JWTs. Forge one it accepts for a more privileged user: the flag comes with it.
hints: Decode the token you receive: what signs it, and how strong is the secret?
Look up JWT secret cracking.

objectives.title: StickyNotes
objectives.prompt: The Arena's StickyNotes service stores notes and renders them. Get a note to render as script: the flag comes back with it.
hints: Which output format renders the notes as HTML?
Look up stored cross-site scripting.
